entries.title: A held batch checks its fix before you approve it
entries.body: When a batch of approved changes fails its checks and your crew fixes it, the batch now runs its checks with that fix as soon as the fix is ready, before you approve it. If they pass and you approve that same version, the batch merges at once with no second run. Changes approved meanwhile go up in the next batch, after your project's wait between batches.
entries.noPicture: No view changes; the batch's pull request runs its checks earlier and merges sooner.
entries.noDocsSite: No docs site page covers how a held batch is repaired.
